title: Companion Taxes and Fees at Booking: Crestline Companion Certificates and Passes Payment Reference
content:
Where the product has the holder pay the companion's taxes and fees — as every product of Crestline Companion Certificates and Passes does — every companion booking carries the companion's taxes and fees, which the holder pays in person as its own charge entry of component taxes and fees on the ledger of the certificate or pass, naming the companion ticket of the booking.

The taxes and fees of a companion booking are fixed only after the certificate's ledger carries that booking's companion fare charge. For a booking made through the reservations call center, the taxes and fees are not worked out until the certificate's ledger also carries that booking's phone booking fee charge.

In terms of the record: until the trip and charge history of the certificate or pass shows that booking's companion fare charge — and, for a call-center booking, that booking's phone booking fee charge as well — the taxes and fees of the booking are not fixed.

## Capability

`pay_companion_taxes_and_fees_93ccd8f8` lets the holder pay, in person, the companion's taxes and fees of a companion booking. One run records one paid charge of component taxes and fees, dated today, on that certificate's or pass's charge history, linked to the companion ticket of the booking; the holder's companion charges rise by the amount paid and the holder sees the taxes and fees as paid.

## How it is invoked

The agent unlocks `pay_companion_taxes_and_fees_93ccd8f8` and hands it over to the holder; the customer themselves runs it.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `companion_id` | Reference number of the companion certificate or pass record the booking was made on, as returned by the companion certificate and pass lookup | identifier |
| `companion_ticket_number` | The companion's ticket number on the booking, exactly as shown on that booking's entry in the companion trip and charge history | 13 digits beginning 419, digits only, no spaces |
| `amount` | The taxes and fees being paid | USD, decimal rounded to 2 decimal places (cents), rounding half up; never negative |

## Return

A receipt confirming the payment: `charge_entry_id`, `companion_id`, `companion_ticket_number`, `charge_component` (always `taxes_and_fees`), `amount_usd` (USD with 2 decimal places, the amount paid), `entry_date` (YYYY-MM-DD, today's business date) and `status` (`payment_recorded` when the payment is on file). No error receipt is defined.
